title: tradecentral
tagline: A decentralized marketplace that utilizes the web3 platform and Lighthouse technology to enable secure and decentralized storage of all data and files related to the marketplace.
description: TradeCentral is a decentralized marketplace that utilizes the Lighthouse technology to enable secure and decentralized storage of all data and files related to the marketplace. The platform allows users to list and purchase real-life products in a peer-to-peer network, providing increased security and anonymity. The goal of the project is to create a secure and decentralized platform for buying and selling goods.
how_its_made:
To build TradeCentral,  we used the Ethereum  Goeril blockchain as the underlying technology for the web3 platform.

We also utilized  Lighthouse for secure storage of all data and files related to the marketplace. 

The front-end of the marketplace was built using Next.Js, React.js. We also used the wagmi library to interact with the Ethereum blockchain and the smart contracts.
